name: nav-blur-elevate
title: Blur-Elevate Nav
description: A sticky navigation surface frosts and compresses when the local article crosses its 72px threshold.

  /* elevation */
  --elev-card:0 8px 24px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.28),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);

[data-theme="light"]{

  --bg-canvas:var(--p-gray-25);--bg-surface:var(--p-gray-0);--bg-raised:var(--p-gray-50);--bg-stage:var(--p-gray-50);--bg-overlay:var(--p-gray-0);
  --border-subtle:rgba(0,0,0,.06);--border-default:rgba(0,0,0,.09);--border-strong:rgba(0,0,0,.14);--border-highlight:rgba(0,0,0,.04);

/* stage-only light mode (DRAMS, skeuomorph, paper): same tokens scoped to the stage */

:root {
  /* duration */
  --dur-micro: 80ms;     /* press-in, tooltip delay */
  --dur-quick: 150ms;    /* hover in, closes, colour */
  --dur-fast: 250ms;     /* menus, modals, tabs, accordions */
  --dur-medium: 350ms;   /* panels, toasts, toggles, check draw */
  --dur-slow: 400ms;     /* text swaps, reveals */
  --dur-xslow: 500ms;    /* icon swaps, pop-in scale */
  --stagger: 40ms;

  /* easing */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);        /* default for enter, move, resize */
  --ease-close: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);        /* exits that should feel decisive */
  --ease-in-out: ease-in-out;                        /* cross-fades, pulses */
  --ease-pop: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1);     /* scale-in with a 1.03 peak */
  --ease-settle: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.25, 0.64, 1);  /* panels and morphs opening */
  --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.35, 0.64, 1);  /* toggle thumb */
  --ease-pop-strong: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.96, 0.64, 1); /* like-heart only */
  --ease-step: cubic-bezier(0.35, -0.02, 0.43, 1);   /* number drum steps */
  /* linear: only continuous loops, shimmers, marquees and scroll scrubbing */

  /* distance / scale / blur */
  --move-micro: 4px; --move-small: 6px; --move-base: 8px; --move-medium: 12px; --move-large: 30px;

.btn:disabled,.chip:disabled,.icon-btn:disabled,.dock-btn:disabled { opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none; }

/* INTRX portable shared Stage Kit */
/* Shared Stage Kit v4. Figma 8:62, 8:63, 8:45 and 187:4482. */
/* Stage metadata owns its palette independently of the page theme. */
.demo-stage.stage[data-stage-theme="dark"] {
  --bg-canvas:var(--p-gray-850);
  --bg-surface:var(--p-gray-800);
  --bg-raised:var(--p-gray-750);
  --bg-stage:var(--p-gray-850);
  --bg-overlay:var(--p-gray-700);
  --border-subtle:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  --border-default:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  --border-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --border-highlight:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  --text-primary:#F1F1F1;
  --text-secondary:#B4B4B4;
  --text-tertiary:#949494;
  --text-inverse:var(--p-gray-950);
  --accent-default:var(--p-orange-500);
  --accent-hover:var(--p-orange-400);
  --accent-subtle:rgba(250,115,25,.14);
  --pro-default:var(--text-primary);
  --status-success:var(--p-green-500);
  --status-danger:var(--p-red-500);
  --focus-ring:var(--p-orange-400);
  background:var(--bg-stage);color-scheme:dark;
}
.demo-stage.stage[data-stage-theme="light"] {
  --bg-canvas:var(--p-gray-25);
  --bg-surface:var(--p-gray-0);
  --bg-raised:var(--p-gray-50);
  --bg-stage:var(--p-gray-50);
  --bg-overlay:var(--p-gray-0);
  --border-subtle:rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  --border-default:rgba(0,0,0,.09);
  --border-strong:rgba(0,0,0,.14);
  --border-highlight:rgba(0,0,0,.04);
  --text-primary:var(--p-gray-950);
  --text-secondary:#5C5C5C;
  --text-tertiary:#666;
  --text-inverse:var(--p-gray-0);
  --accent-default:var(--p-orange-500);
  --accent-hover:var(--p-orange-600);
  --accent-subtle:rgba(250,115,25,.10);
  --pro-default:var(--text-primary);
  --status-success:var(--p-green-600);
  --status-danger:var(--p-red-600);
  --focus-ring:var(--p-orange-600);
  background-color:var(--bg-stage);
  background-image:url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,');
  background-position:-36px -170px;background-size:420px 260px;background-repeat:no-repeat;
  border-radius:14px;box-shadow:none;color-scheme:light;
}
.demo-stage.stage { color:var(--text-primary); }
.stage-dock .dock-btn {
  background:var(--p-gray-700);color:var(--p-gray-25);
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.06);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
}
/* Match the Kit's whole-pixel hug while preserving native sizing as fallback. */
@supports (width:calc-size(max-content,round(up,size,1px))) {
  .dock-btn { width:calc-size(max-content,round(up,size,1px)); }
}
/* A v4 thumbnail keeps two Kit pills while retaining every original action. */
.stage-dock .dock-more { position:relative; }
.stage-dock .dock-more[hidden] { display:none; }
.stage-dock .dock-more::after { content:"";position:absolute;inset:-8px 0; }
.stage-dock .dock-overflow {
  position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 8px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:6px;width:max-content;min-width:160px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  background:var(--p-gray-700);color:var(--p-gray-25);box-shadow:var(--elev-popover);
}
.stage-dock .dock-overflow[hidden] { display:none; }
.stage-dock .dock-overflow .dock-btn {
  width:100%;min-height:44px;height:auto;justify-content:flex-start;padding:6px 12px;
  white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-align:left;line-height:16px;
}

/* Tile card: a lifted surface with the Stage inset as a framed screen. */
.tile{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.025),rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%),var(--bg-surface);border-color:var(--border-subtle);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 var(--border-highlight);transition:border-color var(--dur-quick) var(--ease-out),transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out),box-shadow var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)}

.install-note,.eyebrow,.center-heading .type-meta,.group-tabs span,.section-more .type-meta,.library-nav span,.nav-group>p,
.stage-readout,.a11y-chips>p,.a11y-chips span,.agent-ask .type-meta,.agent-command,.palette-footer,.palette-footer .kbd{font-size:11px}
.source-toolbar .badge--soon,.topnav .badge--soon{height:18px;padding:0 6px}
@media(max-width:1250px){.stage-readout{font-size:11px}}
@media(max-width:600px){.stage-readout,.palette-footer,.palette-footer .kbd,.source-toolbar [role="tab"]{font-size:11px}}

/* Stage presentation (M2). A soft key light lifts dark Stages off the card,
   and the idle play control moves to a corner so it never covers the work. */
.demo-stage.stage[data-stage-theme="dark"]{background-image:radial-gradient(90% 75% at 50% -8%,rgba(255,255,255,.04),rgba(255,255,255,0) 70%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.035)}
.stage-play,.tile--landing .stage-play,.tile-grid[data-density="rows"] .stage-play{top:16px;left:16px;width:32px;height:32px;background:rgba(18,18,18,.72);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.12);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);transition:background-color var(--dur-quick) var(--ease-out)}
.stage-play img{width:15px;height:15px}
.stage-play:hover{background:rgba(36,36,36,.9)}
@media(max-width:600px){.stage-play,.tile--landing .stage-play,.tile-grid[data-density="rows"] .stage-play{top:16px;left:16px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.stage-play{transition:none}}
/* Scrollable demo panes use quiet scrollbars instead of the OS default.
   Zero specificity, so a demo's own scrollbar styling still wins. */

:where(.demo-stage.stage[data-stage-theme="light"]) *{scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(0,0,0,.22) transparent}
